The '''Keeper of the Whills''' was a person responsible for adding entries into the [[Journal of the Whills/Legends|Journal of the Whills]].

==Biography==
Around [[104 ABY]], the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] related the story of the [[Skywalker family/Legends|Skywalker family's]] exploits to a Keeper of the Whills, focusing on the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="MakingROTS">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref>
